input.brief: aRa Events Studio invitation-led immersive photography and celebration site with user-pinned liquid glass controls and real 3D atmosphere

direction.name: The name as a monument
direction.idea: The name is the headline. Set it so large that it becomes architecture: as wide as the viewport, cropped by an edge, or stacked to fill the screen. Nothing else on the first screen competes; the description of what this is drops to a single small sentence. The idea comes from treating the name's letters as material. Ask what the subject can do to its own name: a photograph of the work sits inside a counter or replaces a letter, the name repeats down the page like a reel, the letters are split to opposite corners and the page happens between them. In the study this was the single most common device among sites scoring 7.5 or more.
direction.composition: First screen: the wordmark spans 88–100% of the viewport width (font-size 16–24vw, set with a clamp so it never wraps), anchored either to the bottom edge with its descenders nearly touching it, or dead centre with everything else pushed to the corners. One line of supporting text at 16–20px sits in a corner on a shared margin; navigation is three or four words in the opposite corner. After the hero the page is deliberately small and calm: a narrow text column or a simple two-column grid, so the contrast with the monument holds. The name returns once more at full width as the footer, in the inverse colours. Margins are tight (20–32px) so the type reaches the edges. Two type sizes do nearly all the work: the monument and a small text size, with one mid size for section headings.
direction.typography: One family. The display cut must survive enormous sizes: tight tracking (-0.04 to -0.07em), leading 0.8–0.9, optical kerning on. Section headings are modest (28–40px) on purpose.
direction.colour: Two values carry the page (ground and ink). The accent, if used at all, appears on one thing only: the single action or the inset image frame. The footer inverts ground and ink.
direction.imagery: Few images, used as inserts in the typography rather than as illustrations beside it: one photograph inside or behind the name (a 4:5 or 1:1 frame replacing a letter, or tucked between two words), then a short run of large full-width or half-width photographs further down. Square corners. No collage of small thumbnails.
direction.richness: Scale. The size of the name against the smallness of everything else is the entire visual event, so protect both ends: do not shrink the name to make room, and do not let body text creep above 20px.
direction.pitfalls: A long name set small is just a logo. If the name has more than about 12 characters, stack it on two lines or crop it with the viewport edge; never drop below 12vw. Do not add a second big headline under the name. Do not decorate the letters.

hero.name: Name under a photograph
hero.blueprint: A full-bleed photograph fills the top 58% of the 1440×900 viewport, touching the top, left and right edges, `object-fit: cover`, with its focal point in the upper two-thirds. The lower 42% is a flat ground colour that butts against the photograph with no gap. The name runs across this band on one line, spanning all 12 columns between 24px margins, at clamp(120px, 19vw, 300px), tracking -0.05em, line-height 0.85, its baseline 28px above the bottom edge so descenders nearly touch it. Fit the size to the length of the name so it never wraps. In the strip of ground between photograph and name, 24px under the photograph's edge, sits one row at 17px: the supporting sentence on columns 1–5 at the left margin, and the single action as a small solid rectangular button flush to the right margin. Navigation is four text links at 15px laid over the photograph's top-right corner, 24px in, with a neutral scrim behind that row only if the image is light there. No logo is repeated: the name is the logo. Nothing else is on the screen.
hero.mobile: The photograph takes the top 50svh at full width, re-cropped around its focal point. The name sits under it at 23vw on one line; a name longer than seven characters breaks onto two lines at 21vw, line-height 0.85, and fills the band down to a 16px bottom margin. The supporting sentence at 16px and the action button stack above the name on the left margin. The links collapse to one 'Menu' word over the photograph, top-right.
hero.headline: The name itself on one line, up to about 12 characters at 19vw (drop towards 13vw for longer names), and at most two lines on a phone.

motion.name: Scaling wordmark
motion.description: The giant name responds to the scroll: as the first screen leaves, the wordmark scales down a few percent (or grows from 0.94 to 1 as the footer arrives) on a scroll-linked timeline, so the monument feels heavy. Travel stays under 8%. Static fallback where scroll timelines are unsupported. Recipe: 'Scroll-linked progress' in references/motion.md, animating `scale`.

sections.name: Right-half paragraph, lone photo
sections.blueprint: No heading. On a 12-column grid with 5vw margins, one statement paragraph of 45–70 words occupies columns 7–12 only, set at clamp(24px, 2.2vw, 34px) with leading 1.25 and a first-line indent of 3em. Its top edge sits 18vh below the section top. Columns 1–6 stay empty except for a single square photograph, 20vw wide, in columns 1–3, placed so its top aligns with the paragraph's last line and it hangs below the text by most of its height. A five-line note at 14px, 180px wide, sits in columns 1–2, 96px beneath the photograph. Section padding is 160px top and bottom. Nothing is centred: the paragraph's left edge is the midpoint of the page, and later text blocks on the page may reuse that line. Holds one paragraph, one photograph and one note.
sections.mobile: The paragraph comes first at 22px, full width with 20px margins and no indent. The photograph follows at 62% width, pushed to the right margin, in a 4:5 crop instead of square. The small note sits to its left, bottom-aligned with the photograph, in the remaining 30% of the width.

sections.name: Prints dropped on the headline
sections.blueprint: A flat colour field 100svh tall. A two-line headline of two to four words in an ultra-condensed or ultra-heavy face is centred, each line clamp(120px, 14vw, 210px) tall with leading 0.85. Two portrait photographs, each about 26vw wide at 3:4 with an 8px solid white border like a print, are absolutely placed on top of the headline's centre: one rotated −8 degrees, one +6 degrees, overlapping each other by a third and hiding roughly half the letters, so the eye completes the words. A third, smaller print (16vw) may sit at the lower right, cropped by the section's bottom edge. One plain sentence at 16px sits at the bottom-left margin, 24px from the edges. The prints are above the type in the stacking order; hovering one brings it to the front and straightens it to 0 degrees over 200ms. Nothing else is on the field.
sections.mobile: Headline lines at 30vw, still two lines, centred in a 78svh field. Two prints only, each 52vw wide, rotated −6 and +5 degrees, overlapping at the headline's centre. The small sentence sits at the bottom-left margin at 15px.

sections.name: One-size name columns
sections.blueprint: Pure text at one size. Three columns start on columns 1, 4 and 7 of the 12-column grid, leaving columns 10–12 empty on purpose. Each column opens with a group name in full ink and continues with a tight stack of six to ten capability names in the soft ink, all at 16–17px, regular weight, line-height 1.25, no bullets and no symbols; one blank line separates group name from stack. Hovering a name brings it to full ink and shows a one-line description in a fixed spot: the top of the empty columns 10–12, at the same size. The heading is no larger than 28px; two or three words, alone on column 1, 96px above the columns. Give the section 20vh of empty ground above and below, so the smallness reads as decided. Works on light or deep grounds.
sections.mobile: Columns stack with 40px between groups; text rises to 18px with line-height 1.4 for touch. Group names stay in full ink. Hover descriptions are dropped; each group ends instead with one sentence in the soft ink that sums it up. The heading is 24px, 48px above.

sections.name: Band of unequal panels
sections.blueprint: A modest heading, then one wide band of pictures. The heading, two to four words at 36–44px, starts at column 3, left of centre, with 64px beneath it. The band spans the full viewport width edge to edge and is 68svh tall: four photographs standing side by side with no gaps and deliberately unequal widths, a flex row with flex-grow values of 5, 2, 3 and 2. Each panel is cropped with object-fit: cover to a tall slice, so the band reads as one folded view. The first panel carries a two-line title at 28px in paper colour at its top-left, 24px in, over a neutral scrim that covers only that corner. Hovering a panel raises its flex-grow to 6 over 500ms while the others give way; without hover the widths simply stay. One caption line at 16px sits under the band at the left margin.
sections.mobile: The heading sits on the margin at 28px. The band becomes a two-by-two block with no gaps, 84svh tall in total: the first row split 64/36 and the second 36/64, so the slices stay unequal. The title stays on the first panel. No hover behaviour.

sections.name: The email as display type
sections.blueprint: The section is 100svh in the inverse of the page's colours. A single email address is set as one line of display type spanning the content width: the font-size is fitted so the address runs from margin to margin (about 7–9vw for 20 characters; break after the @ onto two lines if it is longer than 26), light or regular weight, tight tracking, sitting on a baseline 12vh above the bottom edge. It is a `mailto:` link; on hover the whole line takes the accent ink. In the top-left corner, a sentence of up to 12 words at 20–22px says what to write about. In the two bottom corners at 14px: phone and city at the left, two or three social links at the right. No heading and no form. For a pinned ending, make the section `position: sticky; bottom: 0` beneath the page so the previous section lifts off it.
sections.mobile: The address breaks after the @ onto two lines at 11.5vw, left-aligned, sitting at 55% of an 86svh screen. The sentence sits at the top-left at 18px. Phone, city and social links stack at the bottom-left at 15px with 12px between them.

sections.name: Columns above, wordmark below
sections.blueprint: The footer inverts ground and ink and fills a whole viewport (min-height 100svh), arranged as three rows in a grid (auto 1fr auto). Top row, 40px from the edge: four small columns on the 12-column grid (address, navigation, social, hours or contact), each a plain list at 15–16px with its first line in the full ink and the rest in the softer ink. Middle row: empty. Bottom row: the wordmark alone, sized to run from the left margin to the right margin on one line. Set it as inline SVG text with a `viewBox` fitted to the word and `width: 100%`, or tune `font-size` in `vw` to the letter count, so it never wraps; its baseline sits 20px above a single line of legal text at 13px. With `position: sticky; bottom: 0` and a lower `z-index` than the page, the last section slides away to uncover it.
sections.mobile: Columns become two by two at 15px with 32px between rows, at the top. A gap of about 20svh follows. The wordmark spans the full width at the bottom; a name longer than ten letters stacks on two lines, each fitted to the width. Legal line beneath at 12px.

references.name: Nia Creative
references.idea: The three-letter wordmark becomes a slot-machine reel: the name repeats vertically and its middle letter is swapped for a square of client photography or video.
references.hero: Pale grey field with a slim nav: bracketed lowercase logo top-left, four uppercase mono links centred, a black pill button top-right. The centre 43% of the width holds a vertical reel of the wordmark stacked three times in very heavy black grotesk, each row about 230px tall; in every row the middle letter is replaced by a square photo or video tile (surfers, a woman holding glasses over her eyes, a burger). The middle row is sharp; rows above and below fade out through gradient masks. A bottom strip carries a mono descriptor at left and city plus live clock at right. A plum band starts at the fold.
references.type: A heavy, tightly tracked grotesk (xgnl) carries the wordmark, a 70px lowercase section word and bold 20 to 34px statements; body is the same face at 14px, bold. Geist Mono in small capitals handles nav, categories, bracketed indexes and the clock.
references.colour: #f3f3f3 #574d56 #515144 #1c1c1c #b9aebd #b3b586 — Pale grey base with black type. Two muted full-width bands, dusty plum and olive, set their text in a lighter tint of the band colour rather than white. Photography supplies the saturation.
references.imagery: Flash-lit hospitality and lifestyle photography plus short video: cocktails, hotel rooms, food, trail runners. Portrait tiles with one or two large rounded corners, square tiles inside the wordmark, and an edge-to-edge three-up strip.
references.layout: 28px side margins and a three-column grid for work. Big lowercase section words sit flush left with a small paragraph flush right. Sections alternate pale grey grids, coloured statement bands and full-bleed image strips; a black rounded nav bar pins to the top after the hero.

sections.description: Dusty plum band about one viewport tall. A bold 34px statement in pale lilac sits top-left across half the width, one phrase underlined with a hand-drawn stroke. Lower left, a small heading and eight industries in tiny uppercase mono split into two bulleted columns. At the right margin a tall portrait photo, about 20% of the width, with large rounded corners, overlaps the band's top edge and leaves the middle of the band empty.

A 70px heavy lowercase word flush left with a three-line 14px paragraph flush right on the same baseline. Below, three equal columns with wide gutters: each has a portrait image narrower than its column with a large radius on the bottom-right corner only, then a 20px project name, a mono uppercase category and a four-line bold description. Rows repeat with no dividers or card backgrounds.

Three photographs or clips butt together edge to edge with no gaps, each a third of the viewport wide and about 40% of a screen tall. Immediately below, an olive band: a three-line 26px statement in pale olive at left with one underlined phrase, two lines of small copy beneath it, and a small rounded portrait image tucked into the lower right corner.

Services as stacked sheets. Each is a full-width panel with a 1px outline and large top-corner radius that slides up over the previous one. The left half is empty except for a centred column: a bracketed mono index, a 26px bold title and four centred lines of sub-services. The right half is one photograph with rounded corners filling the panel height.

steal: Drop a photo tile into the wordmark in place of one letter and run the lockup as a vertical reel with masked top and bottom rows.
On coloured bands, set type in a lighter tint of the band's own hue instead of white to keep the band calm.
Round only one corner of each image tile, the same corner every time, as a quiet signature shape.

references.name: NOTHIN’
references.idea: The studio's name set as a wordmark so large it is the whole hero, repeated in inverted colours as the footer, so 'nothing' is literally the only content on screen.
references.hero: The captured hero frame is a black preloader wipe; this describes the loaded state. White field. A custom heavy geometric wordmark in black spans the full width between 1% margins, vertically centred, about 30% of the viewport tall, its apostrophe hanging at the top-right. Top-left: a two-line statement at about 1.6vw with a small black pill button under it. Top-right: a tiny menu label with a four-dot icon. Along the bottom edge: a one-line studio descriptor at left, two social links and a language chip at right. Everything else is empty white, with no image and no colour.
references.type: PP Neue Montreal medium for statements at up to about 5vw, sentence case, tight tracking and leading; the Book cut for small text; IBM Plex Mono for tiny grey project labels. The wordmark is custom heavy geometric lettering at close to 100vw. Only three text sizes: statement, caption, micro-label.
references.colour: #ffffff #000000 #2b47e6 #2f5d33 #bfbfbf — Strict black and white that flips by section: white hero and intro, black works and footer. The only colour comes from inside the imagery, chiefly electric-blue foil and fern green.
references.imagery: 3D renders of inflated chrome, crumpled blue foil and bubble-wrap hearts on black; project shots are brand mock-ups photographed in settings (a card among ferns, a laptop on a dark desk). Hard-edged rectangles of varied size, square corners.
references.layout: Margins of about 1%, so content runs nearly edge to edge. The intro is a left headline over a full-width black media panel; the works section places images at irregular widths and horizontal offsets with wide black gaps, each with a mono label and one-line caption above.

sections.description: White section. A two-line statement at about 5vw sits flush left under a small logo mark, filling the top quarter. Below it a black rectangle spans the full content width and runs off the bottom of the viewport, holding a 3D still life clustered at centre. On further scroll the panel shrinks to a small thumbnail docked top-right, while a parenthesised label and a four-line paragraph at caption size appear in two narrow columns at the left.

Black section headed by one bold uppercase word top-left. Project images are placed as a loose scatter: one at about 48% width hugging the left margin, the next narrow and hugging the right margin lower down, the next inset to start 18% across. Above each image sits a tiny grey mono project name, then a one-line white caption at about 1.1vw. A two-line aphorism floats alone at the right between projects. Long stretches of empty black separate items.

Black, full viewport. A two-line invitation at about 5vw at the left in the upper third, with two outlined pill buttons under it; three social links stacked at about 78% across. The wordmark repeats in white at full width, anchored to the bottom, with a single row of micro-text credits beneath it.

steal: Make the hero nothing but the name: a wordmark scaled to the full viewport width on a blank field, with only a two-line statement and one small button in a corner.
Repeat the hero wordmark in inverted colours as the footer so the page opens and closes on the same shape.
Place case-study images at different widths and horizontal offsets on a black field, each with a micro mono label and a single-line caption above it instead of a card.
references.media: No picture on the desktop first screen: a full-width black wordmark on white covers about 30% of the height. Then an inset showreel with 18px gutters scrubs down into a box in the right third as text arrives on the left, a staggered two-column mosaic of 48, 32 and 65% widths, a pinned full-bleed brand film with a blurred copy behind it as a halo, cut-out 3D objects on black with letters tumbling between them, and the wordmark again, inverted, as the footer; 17 images and 4 muted looping videos.
references.motion: The preloader (on the phone capture) morphs a 3D inflatable through three forms while a counter runs down to 000, then white rises in a hard-edged mask to reveal the wordmark. Lenis: the showreel scrubs at 3, works cards drift at their own speeds (y scrub 1.5, yPercent scrub 3), the film pins for one screen, heading letters split and scatter, and services letters and objects tumble in on power2.in at random 0.25-0.69s durations; the house ease is cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) at 0.5-0.6s.

references.name: Sarah & Matt Wedding
references.idea: The site is the invitation: a letterpress-style card rendered as a physical object opens the page, and its ornaments, rules and small typographic parts become the components for everything after it.
references.hero: A flat blush-pink field fills the viewport. Top-left sits a gold filigree monogram about 120px square; three plain nav links are centred on the same line; a solid gold rectangular RSVP button sits top-right. Below, centred, a portrait invitation card half the viewport wide starts 200px down and is cropped by the bottom edge, with a soft halo shadow and a debossed border with scalloped inner corners. On the card: the two names in a large italic swash serif, staggered left and right against two ornamental roundels, separated by hairline rules carrying tiny wide-tracked caps for date and time.
references.type: Card names in a high-contrast italic serif with swash capitals (drawn in canvas); section titles in a light roman serif around 5vw; Instrument Sans 18px for body and nav; Spezia Extended in tiny tracked caps for dates and addresses. Three clear tiers.
references.colour: #e9c4be #faf7f5 #0d0b0a #241c22 #9b7948 #4f5660 — Each section takes its own field: blush pink hero, warm cream story, dark plum venue details, black footer. Gold is reserved for ornament and the RSVP button; a coral button appears once on dark.
references.imagery: A canvas-rendered paper card with emboss and grain; a warm, grainy golden-field landscape as a full-bleed band behind it; candid couple snapshots in equal portrait cards with rounded corners; night venue photos overlapping at two sizes.
references.layout: Outer margins of about 50px. The hero is centred; the story is a horizontally scrolling row of text-above-photo columns; the details section splits roughly 45/55 between text and overlapping photos. Large vertical gaps separate sections, each on its own colour field.

sections.description: A story timeline. A small sans heading sits at the left margin with two outlined circular arrow buttons at the right. Under it runs a full-width ruler of fine vertical tick marks acting as a scrubber. Below, a horizontally scrolling row of columns about 280px wide: each has a one-line bold caption, three lines of small grey text, a large gap, then a portrait photo with 12px rounded corners. Columns bleed off both edges; one photo is black and white.

A cream field with a single light serif title at roughly 5vw on the left margin and a three-line small sans paragraph pushed to the far-right column on the same baseline, leaving the middle empty. Below, the date in medium sans introduces a row of large light-serif times divided by vertical hairlines, with a dark rounded image card starting in the right half.

On a dark plum field, split in two. Left 45%: small sans labels for arrival and ceremony, an outlined box holding venue, street and city in tiny tracked extended caps separated by slashes, then a five-row accordion with hairline dividers and chevrons, then a coral button beside a text link. Right 55%: a tall night photo of the venue facade bleeding off the top, with a smaller square photo overlapping its lower-right corner.

A band of grainy rose-brown texture, then black. A dim monogram at left, a four-link column at centre, and at right the date, boxed address and time lines repeated from the invitation in tracked extended caps with hairlines. The couple's names run across the full width at about 22vw in the italic swash serif, filled with a blue-gold glitter texture and cropped by the bottom edge.

steal: Make a real-world object (an invitation, a ticket, a label) the hero and reuse its small typographic parts, such as a boxed address line with slashes, as recurring components down the page.
Repeat the hero lettering in the footer at full-bleed scale with a material texture fill, cropped by the bottom edge.
Place a section title at the left margin and its short paragraph in the far-right column on the same baseline, leaving the centre empty.
